messages:
lena: Quick poll  coffee situation: beans in hopper or single-serve pods? Both have passionate camps apparently. :coffee:
omar: Beans for flavour. Pods are lazy luxury tho. :sunglasses:
zack: Team pods here. No grind maintenance = no drama.
ari: I'm in favour of beans if we commit to a grinder-clean rota. Grinder's been used as a shelf for half the week :grimacing:
lena: Grinder-clean rota idea: 1 week on, 2 weeks off rotation? We could do a simple sheet. Thoughts?
stella: I'll make the sheet. Quick Q: who's paying for beans? snack jar? expense?
omar: Snack jar is fine. Or I can pick up a trial bag if people want to taste test.
zack: Vote: :white_check_mark: pods, :coffee: beans. I'll vote pods but down for a taste test.
ari: :coffee: (beans)
lena: :coffee: (beans)
stella: :coffee: I will set up a petty-cash jar labeled "Kitchen Coffee" at reception.
omar: Also, can we please stop leaving used espresso puck in the sink trap? It's clog city. Facilities-bot, can we get a gentle PSA?
facilities-bot: @channel Facilities PSA: Please scrape espresso puck into compost bin (next to sink) and run grinder brush after use. Repeated clogs will trigger a formal work order. Thanks!
zack: Noted. Also the digital scale vanished yesterday. Anyone borrow it?
ari: I borrowed it for a baking day, forgot to return. Sorry! I'll drop it back by 11am.
lena: Amazing 495. Last thing: stash policy for shared sandwiches? Someone left a mystery tub and it's now a science experiment. Proposed rule: label with name + date or toss after 48h.
stella: Agreed. I'll add that to the sheet too.
omar: If we go beans, I recommend this local roast: https://tiny.coffee/redwood-blend (cheap trial pack). Also pods option: https://tiny.coffee/pods-eco
zack: Taste-off tomorrow at 10:30? I'll bring pods, omar bring beans, Ari brings biscotti (bribe).
ari: Deal. Grinder-clean crew: meet 10:15. I'll bring gloves.
lena: Love it. Stella will post the rota link in #lunch-plans and stick a laminated sign by the machine: "Label food. Clean grinder. Be kind to beans." :label:
facilities-bot: Work order template for missing supplies: 
```
Title: Kitchen supplies restock / maintenance
Desc: Missing scale/grinder check; restock coffee filters; inspect sink trap
Priority: Medium
Owner: facilities
```
stella: Rota & sign done: https://docs.internal/kitchen-rota (added petty cash instructions). See you all at 10:15 rescue/clean. :broom:
